failures.diagnosis: Redisson 4.7.0 throws UnsupportedOperationException from RedisQueuedBatchExecutor when discard() is called on a REDIS_WRITE_ATOMIC batch before execution; the new compatibility test exercised this upstream-broken path.

evidence.outcome: Failed before the fix with six UnsupportedOperationException failures from RedisQueuedBatchExecutor, then succeeded after the test was gated for latest dependencies.
Succeeded against the pinned Redisson dependency before and after the compatibility changes.

failures.diagnosis: Shared test classes linked BatchOptions.ExecutionMode and an inferred BatchResult lambda descriptor, so JUnit discovery failed with NoClassDefFoundError on supported Redisson versions that predate those API types.

evidence.outcome: Initially reproduced JUnit discovery failures for missing Redisson API types; succeeded after newer batch APIs were isolated behind reflection and the inferred BatchResult descriptor was removed.
Succeeded for all targeted Redisson compatibility suites, the pinned atomic discard test, and Java formatting.
